items.title: FCA decides to ban and fine Daniel Thomas over unauthorised pension transfer advice
items.summary: The FCA has decided to ban Daniel Thomas from working in financial services and fine him £742,700 after finding he recklessly gave defined benefit pension transfer advice he was neither qualified nor allowed to give.

items.summary:

items.title: Crypto, Banks Take Clarity Act Lobbying Fight to Senators' Home States
items.summary: Crypto advocates and community bankers are targeting lawmakers in their home states as the Senate prepares for a September 15 procedural vote.

items.title: Secret Service Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto Tied to Telegram Bazaar Behind Global Scams
items.summary: Blockchain sleuths at Elliptic traced the money, Treasury sanctioned the marketplace, and Xinbi—which ran $24 billion through a Telegram scam bazaar—called the freeze unfair.

items.title: While Bitcoin Devs Debate Next Moves, IonQ Unveils Superion 256 Quantum Computer
items.summary: The company has built its first chips and begun testing prototypes as it seeks to manufacture quantum computers in larger quantities.

items.title: Mexican Musician and Family Killed Over Bitcoin Cold Wallet Believed to Hold Millions
items.summary: Mexican prosecutors allege suspects targeted Camilo Séptimo keyboardist Jonathan Meléndez and his family while searching for a cold wallet they believed contained millions in Bitcoin.

items.title: Consensys Is Splitting in Two as MetaMask Goes Its Own Way
items.summary: Consensys Software Inc. will become MetaMask, while a newly formed Consensys will take over the firm's Ethereum protocols and institutional blockchain infrastructure business.

items.title: German Finance Ministry Drafts 25% Tax on Crypto Gains From 2027
items.summary: Anything bought before 2027 keeps the twelve-month exemption, so the change lands only on Germany's future crypto buyers.

items.title: Morning Minute: Venice’s VVV Token Soars After OpenAI Dispute
items.summary: Concerns over frontier AI labs stealing user data has driven demand for private inference (or at least tokens tied to private inference).

items.title: UK Crime Agency Warns of 'Innovative Use' of Crypto by Launderers
items.summary: The agency ranks cryptoassets third among nine economic crime priorities, and says it wants to generate its own targets.

items.title: Mexico Seizes 300 Crypto Mining Rigs Wired Into a Hydroelectric Dam
items.summary: Forensic accountants are tracing who paid for the mining hardware, and money laundering has not been ruled out.

items.title: Jack Dorsey's Block Applies for Bank Charter to Custody Bitcoin
items.summary: Builders Bank would consolidate custody work Block now runs under more than 50 state money transmitter licenses.

items.title: Bitcoin Holds, Wall Street Stalls as Oil Shock Revives Fed Hike Bets
items.summary: Bitcoin is defending its golden zone support while the S&P 500 grinds inside its tightest range yet, both waiting on Friday's inflation report before the Fed's September 16 rate call.

items.title: Visa Taps Onchain Lending to Finance Stablecoin Card Programs
items.summary: The payment processor giant is pairing payment settlement data with blockchain lending tools to help fintechs and stablecoin-linked card programs access working capital.

items.title: Strive Buys $109 Million in Bitcoin, Pushes Preferred Stock Toward $1 Billion
items.summary: The Vivek Ramaswamy-founded asset manager added 1,375 BTC last week, its third straight week of 5%-plus growth.

items.title: Cronos Erased Two Hours of Transactions to Reverse $111 Million DeFi Exploit
items.summary: The rollback reversed legitimate activity alongside the attack, while $9.19 million remains unrecovered, according to Cronos.

items.title: Robinhood Takes Equity Stake in Crypto.com, Taps Exchange to Power Prediction Markets
items.summary: The multi-year deal makes OG.com the infrastructure and clearing engine behind Robinhood's fastest-growing business.

items.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Adds $70 Million in Ethereum, Holdings Reach 5.93 Million ETH
items.summary: The company says it holds roughly 4.9% of Ethereum’s supply, with most of its tokens staked to earn rewards.

items.title: Strategy's Return to Bitcoin Buying Lasted Exactly One Week
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm spent $176.3 million on its own preferred stock, and doubled the buyback program's authorization to $2 billion.
